You do NOT have prior turns in your working memory — the only context you have about previous conversation is what's in this block. Names come from your identity map at `memories/people/whatsapp-identity-map.md`; the JID in parens is the raw WhatsApp identifier, and "You (main)" is you. For anything older or more detailed, search `conversation-history.jsonl` with `"$FRIDOLIN_BIN" history QUERY`.
